name: app-dark-defi-dashboard-teal-glow
title: Dark DeFi dashboard on a teal-glow starfield
whatItIs: A project cover: black starfield with a teal glow at the right, the studio name and discipline chips at top left, and a tilted desktop dashboard with sidebar, an area chart, collateral totals and an earn table.
whatItMeans: Technical, premium and futuristic; the glow suggests energy and live data.
techniques: Tilt the dashboard in perspective so it feels like a 3D object in space.
Use one cool glow (teal) to light the UI from one side.
Limit the chart palette to one line colour with a gradient fill.
Put small outlined chips at the top for context instead of a big heading.
Keep panels near-black with hairline borders for layered depth.
bestFor: Crypto, trading and analytics product covers

vocabulary.definition: A line chart with the area under it filled.
A soft light bloom in an accent colour behind or beside an object.
The first image of a portfolio project.
A small rounded tag with a short label.
